title: Clinic Management Software Cost in India
seoTitle: Clinic Management Software Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What custom clinic and diagnostic centre software costs in India: appointments, EMR, billing, lab reports, WhatsApp. Cost bands, timelines and cost drivers.
summary: Custom clinic management software in India typically costs ₹4 lakh to ₹10 lakh for a single clinic with appointments, patient records and billing, ₹10 lakh to ₹25 lakh for a multi-branch set-up with lab integration and a patient app, and more for hospital-grade systems. Integrations and compliance drive the cost more than screens.

costBands.includes: Appointments, patient records, prescriptions, billing, WhatsApp reminders
Branches, lab orders and reports, doctor app, payments, dashboards
IPD, pharmacy, insurance/TPA, ABDM integration, detailed audit trails

dataPoints.label: Biggest cost drivers
dataPoints.value: Number of branches and roles, lab machine and LIS integration, ABDM (health ID) integration

dataPoints.label: Running costs
dataPoints.value: Hosting, WhatsApp messages, SMS, support: typically a few thousand to ₹30,000 a month

dataPoints.label: Data protection
dataPoints.value: Health data is sensitive personal data; access control and audit logs are required

dataPoints.label: Packaged alternative
dataPoints.value: Clinic SaaS subscriptions suit standard workflows; custom suits groups with specific processes

body:
## What moves the price

- **Scope of records:** simple visit notes versus structured EMR with templates per speciality.
- **Integrations:** lab analysers, PACS for imaging, payment gateway, ABDM.
- **Patient-facing features:** booking, report downloads, reminders on WhatsApp.
- **Branches and roles:** each adds permissions, reports and testing.

## Build or subscribe

If a clinic SaaS fits your workflow, subscribe. Custom software earns its cost when you run several branches, a diagnostic centre with specific reporting, or need deep integration with existing systems. See [software for healthcare clinics and diagnostic centres](/blog/software-for-healthcare-clinics-and-diagnostic-centres).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Can reports be sent to patients on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes, as secure links or PDFs through the WhatsApp Business Platform, with patient consent.
Not for every clinic today, but it is increasingly expected; plan the data model so it can be added.
